description: This file defines a React component named UserProfileModal that renders a modal dialog displaying a user's core profile information, including name, email, department, and tenant ID. It manages focus trapping, accessibility, and animations for a responsive, accessible user profile modal.

methods.name: getFocusableElements
methods.description: Retrieves all focusable and visible elements within a given root element to facilitate focus trapping.

methods.name: trapTabKey
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation (Tab and Shift+Tab) to trap focus within the modal container.
